summary: Iteration 4 fully verified. Backend: 25/25 pytest cases pass (10 new iter4 + 15 regression iter3). Frontend: RFP form auto-populates read-only Master Tracking Sheet Ref, live-updates on date_of_rfp change, Job Seniority multi-select works, Job Titles textarea captures pasted lines, save/edit persists sequence & data; edit refreshes only the date suffix (seq preserved).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py update_rfp parses seq via string split — robust enough but adding a helper `parse_master_ref_seq()` would DRY the logic between create/update.

next_seq_num() uses count_documents which is not concurrency-safe; two simultaneous POSTs could produce duplicate EV_Q_{NNN}. Acceptable for internal tool but consider an atomic counter (findAndModify on a sequences collection) if traffic grows.
GET /api/rfps/next-ref is not protected by any concurrency guard, so the preview UI value may be stale relative to actual save — mitigated by server-side authoritative overwrite.
RFPForm.jsx computeRef regex `^EV_Q_(\d{3,})` correctly extracts seq for existing RFPs; consistent with backend format.
seed_data_creation: Wiped rfps collection in wipe_db fixture (module scope) for deterministic sequence checks. Left one UI-created RFP (EV_Q_001_20260320) in DB from the frontend test run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_rfp_iter4.py auto-wipes DB via a MongoClient fixture (uses pymongo — installed). Run with `pytest -n 0` (serial) because tests share module-scoped state; xdist loadscope in pytest.ini would still work but wipe fixture runs per worker and can race, so prefer -n 0 for iter4. REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL must be exported from /app/frontend/.env before invoking pytest.
